activation.condition: After using the Elemental Mastery reaction

description.chatFlavor: Until the end of your next turn you gain the benefit of one element (Air, Earth, Fire, or Water).

value:
You add the final element to your Elemental Affinity.

In addition, whenever a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your Reaction to force it to make a Dexterity saving throw. It takes 6d6 damage of a type of your choice (Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, or Lightning) on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Then, until the end of your next turn, you gain one of the following benefits:

  • Air. You have Advantage on all ranged weapon and ranged spell attacks.
  • Earth. At the start of your turn, you gain 20 Temporary Hit Points.
  • Fire. At the start of your turn, each creature of your choice within 5 feet of you takes 2d6 Fire damage.
  • Water. Whenever a creature you can see within 60 feet of you regains Hit Points by spending Hit Point Dice or through a spell or magical ability, it regains an additional 20 Hit Points (apply manually).

You can use this Reaction a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

Automation: the Damage activity targets the attacker; the benefit is then chosen and applied to you by the Elemental Benefit activity.
